normalization.description: Registry of available intensity normalization methods.

outputs.description: Registry of global defaults for each output format.

model.description: Registry of available model architectures and their default parameters.

loss.description: Registry of available loss functions and their default parameters.

metrics.description: Registry of available metrics and their default parameters.

train._comment_device: GPU device for training, e.g. 'cuda:0', 'cuda:1', or 'cpu'.
train._comment_paths: data_path = list of training data directories; save_path = root dir for weights and logs.
train._comment_model: model_name = experiment subfolder under save_path; model_type = architecture key from the model registry above.
train._comment_preprocess: normalize_mode = z-score|min-max|histogram|min-max-gamma; high_cut clips intensity before normalization (null = no clip).
train._comment_loss: Weighted sum of loss functions. Keys are loss names from the loss registry, values are their scalar weights.
train._comment_metrics: Metrics evaluated each metric_interval epochs. Keys from the metrics registry.
train._comment_patch: training_patch_size = [D, H, W] of each 3D crop fed to the model; training_overlay = voxel overlap between adjacent crops; training_neg_keep_ratio = fraction of background-only patches retained.
train._comment_training: training_epochs = total epochs; training_batch_size = patches per GPU step; learning_rate = Adam optimizer LR.

inference._comment_paths: input_path / input_name = source volume location; output_path / output_name = destination for the predicted mask.
inference._comment_preprocess: Same normalization applied at inference. sample_rate controls fraction of voxels sampled for global stats computation.
inference._comment_patch: inference_patch_size = [D, H, W] sliding window; inference_overlay = voxel overlap between windows (larger = smoother tile boundaries, slower).
inference._comment_output: type = output format (Zarr|Scroll-Tiff|Single-Tiff); dtype = output bit depth; resize_order = interpolation order for optional spatial resize.
